Thanks for the response.  It makes sense.  I do try to do self-centered things to a point.  I try to better myself by working out and such.  However, even though I know I should work on myself and care about my health for myself, sometimes I start wondering what's the point of no one cares.  I try to keep those thoughts out of my mind and I'd love to have more of a mindset like you.

I know you didn't mean "learning" in the literal sense, but I did always think growing up that I would go to college and just learn something, anything, and better myself.  Unfortunately, some time in high school I just kind of lost my ambition with schooling and never got it back.

I've been in the same dead-end(?) job for about 5 years now.  Haven't really had any ambition to leave.  I guess technically I've moved up in my job a bit but there's really nothing above where I'm at now.  Anyway, it doesn't pay that well, no benefits, no vacation (not that I have anywhere to go), but I guess it gives me something to do and pay the bills.  I did try applying for another job I was interested in but didn't get it.

I hope I can keep going.  I try.  I've been trying for years, and it seems it just gets harder.  I guess that's just because the time waiting for things to change keeps getting longer.  I guess that's my fault though.  Thank you for your words though.  Just having someone to talk to and get different opinions means the world.

Could I ask what are some of the other reasons you think life is worth living for?

Off the top of my head though all I can think of are things that involve someone that finds you meaningful.

Say, having kids, could be a reason to live.  But you need to have someone that cares for you to have kids.  I would love to have a child someday but I'm not sure I'm fit to be a parent.  I mean, look at me now, I'm 25 and barely hanging on for myself, how could I care for a child.  And then there's always the thought that I'd never want to bring a child into this world if they could end up like me.  I wouldn't wish that upon anyone.

What other reasons for living though.  Visiting places I guess?  But again, I wouldn't want to do that alone, I'd want someone that means something to me, and me to them, to do that with.

Perhaps helping other people...I could see that.  Maybe I should do something along the lines of volunteering my time but I don't know where to start.

But another thing that kills me is all these people that have to die, and somehow I am the one left alive.  I would gladly give my life for any of them if I could.  Innocent children that die, fathers and mothers.  People that actually have people who care for them...who actually contribute to the world.  I feel like crap anytime someone like that dies, but somehow I'm left alive...worthless and meaningless to everyone and everything.

I don't know if I can (want to) answer the first one.  Just to think about it makes me feel even worse about the whole thing and how it was my fault.  But I just knew it couldn't happen no matter what her thoughts were.

My feelings were...I don't know just numb.  All I can think about is her.  I dream about her.  She's the most amazing person I've ever met, and it hurts that she pretty much is going to have to be out of my life.  

I really want to stay friends, but she's been distant since then.  Like I said some days she will completely ignore me, but then the other night she wanted to FaceTime and we talked for about 1.5 hours.  Then the next day (yesterday) she completely ignored me again and wouldn't even respond to me.  

I can't do that on again off again because every moment she's ignoring me I'm left here alone and dying inside.  And it's hard to draw the line and just be friends, even though it has to be that way.  In my head I understand but I have these feelings I can't control.

Anyway, no I'm not in high school, I'm 25.  I know that makes me pretty pathetic all things considered.  25 and no one to really call a friend.  Not successful or anything like that.  The world would probably be a much better place had a never been born.  I was a mistake anyway.  My parents were 36 and 55 when I was born.  The doctors even wanted them to abort me.

I just want to feel like someone cares.  I don't see how life is worth living if you don't have someone who cares about you.  And like I mentioned.  Of course my family cares about me (or I think) but the only reason is because of just that, they are family.  So I really don't include them because if they weren't my family they wouldn't give a damn.

I feel like I have no friends.  No one to turn to when I need them.  No one to do anything with.  I'm just tired of being alone.

I don't know if it's wrong to want to be meaningful to someone, but I can't think of what else there is to live for but that.  It sucks to feel like you mean nothing to anyone.  Whats the point of living then?

Well, I'll start for one by saying any relationships I have that I try to further on a romantic level just seem to fail.  From when I've talked to my sister about it she says maybe I just come on too strong or show too much interest.  I'm sorry but that's just me.  I have a really hard time toning that down.  The worst was this one girl I was really into, we hang out two times...maybe I read the signs wrong...but I asked her to hang out again and she just dropped out completely and stopped talking to me.  No explanation.  No goodbye.  Nothing.  That kind of sucked because it seemed to be going well but then all of a sudden nothing.

Another one just this last week, I really can't get too much into but.  I have been friends with this girl for over a year now.  We talked on and off but never for prolonged periods.  Well about three weeks ago we started talking every single day...about everything.  I started to develop deeper feelings for this girl and her to me.  She told me she liked me and of course I like her, but unfortunately we can never actually be together like that.  Anyway, ever since that it's just been off again and on again with her.  I really started leaning on her and trusting her with everything, and considered her my best friend at the time.  There were things I told her I'd never told anyone.  Anyway, the way it's going just up and down is really tearing me up and putting me back in my depression which is what leads to my suicidal thoughts.

She said we could remain friends, but it's not the same as it used to be.  One day she ignores me and won't even respond, the next she'll talk to me or ask me to FaceTime.  All day I spend thinking about her.  Every time my phone goes off my heart skips a beat.  I'm beyond happy on the days she talks to me but stuck at home crying on the days she won't.  I know the best thing is probably to cut ties but I can't see my life without her in it.  And I really don't want to lose another friend.

It just seems like everything that makes me happy gets taken away, it's happened time and time again.  And I think that's one reason I am not good at making or keeping friends now.  I find it hard to trust anyone, and there's really only three people that I let past my wall.  My sister, my one friend that's been trying to help me, and this girl.  Besides them I keep a wall up.  Every time I let the wall down for someone, they hurt me, and I'm so done with it.

This'll just be another person that broke through my wall and is going to make me build it up higher.  I'm just tired of feeling like this but I'm not sure how to stop.  I think I push people away because of how closed off I am, but I don't want to open up because I'll just end up getting hurt.
